Market today: The mood is cautious on tech, driven by growing anxiety over AI spending budgets and recent weakness in a major hyperscaler. This suggests potential headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-46.24%) and SPAL (-55.51%) are critical, both leveraged and showing massive losses. QQQ (-4.26%) and QQQI (-6.52%) are also near their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further news regarding AI capex and the performance of major tech bellwethers. Also, monitor your stops on QQQ and QQQI.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management, especially on your leveraged and losing positions, given the market's cautious stance on tech spending.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is invalid; price is 136.81. This leveraged position is down 46.24% and decaying. Re-evaluate your stop or consider exiting now.
SPAL: Another leveraged ETF, down 55.51%. Like SOXL, its decay and volatility on margin demand a fresh look at your stop at 21.38.
QQQ & QQQI: Both are near their stops (QQQ at 670, QQQI at 52). Be ready to exit if these levels break to protect capital.
